package main

import (
	"flag"
)

// flag.String("removed-in-comment", "", "a name in a comment is not a flag")

func main() {
	flag.String("real", "", "real")
	decoy := flag.NewFlagSet("decoy", flag.ContinueOnError)
	decoy.String("decoy-only", "", "never parsed by the program; still counted")
	flag.Parse()
}
